# Google Ads Freelancer (googleadsfreelancer.com)

> Diego Willian Zietek, independent Google Ads and paid media consultant with 14+ years of hands-on work. Runs Google Ads, with Meta and Microsoft Advertising when they fit, personally, for a flat monthly fee. Accounts stay in the client's name. Based in Curitiba, Brazil; works remotely in English.

- Market: businesses in the United States, Canada and Europe, and companies from any country that work in English; the UK and Ireland practice is at ppcconsultancy.uk.
- Services: Google Ads management, audits, setup, conversion tracking, consulting, and multi-platform PPC management.
- Fees: a flat monthly fee, never a percentage of ad spend. No long contract.
- Pricing: quoted per account from the form, in US dollars, pounds or euros; no prices are published.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://googleadsfreelancer.com/): Senior Google Ads freelancer, one person on the account.
- [Google Ads management](https://googleadsfreelancer.com/google-ads-management/): Month-to-month management by the person you hired. Flat fee.
- [Google Ads audit](https://googleadsfreelancer.com/google-ads-audit/): Fixed-price PPC audit with fixes ranked by impact. Yours to keep.
- [Google Ads audit example](https://googleadsfreelancer.com/google-ads-audit-example/): A worked audit on an illustrative account: the eight checks, what each one found, and the verdict on budget.
- [PPC consultant](https://googleadsfreelancer.com/freelance-ppc-consultant/): An independent PPC consultant for companies in the US, Canada and Europe, hired directly.
- [Google Ads consultant](https://googleadsfreelancer.com/google-ads-consultant/): Strategy, second opinions and advisory for teams that run their own ads.
- [Google Ads consultation](https://googleadsfreelancer.com/google-ads-consultation/): A one-off working session on your account, with written notes, before or instead of a retainer.
- [Google Ads expert](https://googleadsfreelancer.com/google-ads-expert/): What a senior specialist does differently, how to check it before hiring, and how the engagement works.
- [Landing pages and websites](https://googleadsfreelancer.com/landing-pages/): Campaign landing pages and 3 to 8 page business websites built by the person running the ads, tracked and hosted, with the paperwork handled.
- [B2B PPC](https://googleadsfreelancer.com/b2b-ppc/): Google Search for the buyers already looking, judged on pipeline from the CRM, not on form fills.
- [SaaS PPC](https://googleadsfreelancer.com/saas-ppc/): Google Ads for software companies, measured in qualified pipeline and CAC payback, with a published case.
- [Home services PPC](https://googleadsfreelancer.com/home-services-ppc/): HVAC, plumbing, roofing, electrical: Google Ads built around booked jobs, with a published case.
- [PPC for law firms](https://googleadsfreelancer.com/ppc-for-law-firms/): Google Ads for attorneys: paying for signed clients, not for people comparing fees at $100 a click.
- [Healthcare PPC](https://googleadsfreelancer.com/healthcare-ppc/): Clinics, practices and health brands: inquiries that become appointments, within Google's health policies.
- [Pricing](https://googleadsfreelancer.com/pricing/): What Google Ads freelancers and consultants charge, and how I price.
- [Results](https://googleadsfreelancer.com/results/): Published engagements, with what can and cannot be verified.
- [About Diego](https://googleadsfreelancer.com/about/): Who runs the account, where from, and what is public.
- [FAQ](https://googleadsfreelancer.com/faq/): Answers on hiring a Google Ads freelancer: fees, terms, account access, Search ads and agency work.
- [Contact](https://googleadsfreelancer.com/contact/): Book a call, send the form or write an email. All three reach the same person.

## Guides (what a rule or message in Google Ads means for the business, and what to do)

- [Housing, jobs and credit ads](https://googleadsfreelancer.com/guides/google-ads-housing-employment-credit/): The five targeting options Google bans for home, job and credit ads in the US and Canada, what still works, and how to fix an affected campaign.
- [US privacy laws and Google Ads](https://googleadsfreelancer.com/guides/google-ads-us-privacy-laws/): When the CCPA applies, why it is an opt-out law rather than a cookie banner law, the Do Not Sell or Share link, Global Privacy Control and Google's restricted data processing.
- [Local Services Ads verification](https://googleadsfreelancer.com/guides/local-services-ads-verification/): The Google Verified badge, background checks, license and insurance documents, how long verification takes and why verified ads still get no leads.
- [Where to hire a Google Ads freelancer](https://googleadsfreelancer.com/guides/where-to-hire-google-ads-freelancer/): Open marketplaces, vetted networks or hiring direct: what each route gives you, what the platforms say about themselves, and five checks none of them runs for you.
